description: Prebuilt binary downloads pinned by SHA-256 in the OrcaSlicer v2.5.0 build files: the hashed binary pins listed in excluded_pins of orcaslicer-v2.5.0-source-archives.json (FFmpeg Windows zips, uv, CPython Windows bin-deps and nuget host Python). Same schema as the source-archive manifest so tools/verify-source-archives.py can hash-verify them. A hash match is integrity evidence only; it does not approve anything. Issue #55 slice C.
